content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to show the value of a shift register bit on the [product_name] display using the message text feature, but when I transfer the program, I get an error: [article_no].[version_no]: B011 [Message texts] The I/O status name references an unsupported source. Download PC --> [product_name] failed It seems my device does not support displaying this type of data. In the hardware selection screen of [product_name]Soft, the [version_no] standard appears supported, but the [version_no] ES3 version is not. I'm unsure which [product_name] version I own. According to the markings with three numbers on the device, it seems like I have a [product_name] [article_no] [version_no]. Is there a way to show the value of a shift register bit on the device display? Thank you!

Hello, The message text status for a [product_name] [article_no] only works with inputs and outputs. In [product_name]Soft V[version_no], even if you select a [product_name] [article_no], the software allows linking other binary sources to the status text. However, for a [article_no], only inputs and outputs will work for message texts. Workaround: Have the shift register bit control an unused output (can also use an output from an expansion module), and use this output to manage the message status text display. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The user attempted to show the value of a shift register bit on the [product_name] display via the message text function, but encountered an error due to hardware limitations in the [version_no] ES3 model. The system only supports displaying message text for input and output sources, not for internal bits. There was also confusion regarding support differences in the hardware selection versus actual functionality in [product_name]Soft V[version_no].
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to show any bit, including internal bits like those from a shift register, on the [product_name] display's message text area if both hardware and software claim support.
